notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.4 Major: [/p][list][*][p]Fixed dialogue inconsistencies[/p][/*][*][p]New and updated UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Removed two newly discovered softlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character portrait for Elliot[/p][/*][*][p]New portrait expressions for Julia[/p][/*][*][p]New, deeper dialogue branches for some conversations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some NPC not being clickable during certain day states[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] Minor: [/p][list][*][p]Fixed typos[/p][/*][*][p]Conversant names not showing up in some parts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some interactables not highlighting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor navigation issues[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.3 Major [/p][list][*][p]Fixed dialogue inconsistencies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not being able to load saves after end credits without restarting[/p][/*][*][p]Removed newly discovered softlock[/p][/*][/list][p] Minor [/p][list][*][p]Fixed sound issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added new UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected fonts in some UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed newly discovered typos[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content: [p]Major[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed soft locks in the story that we hadn’t anticipated[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with characters appearing in the wrong places—or not appearing at all when they should[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where saving could lock the game in certain scenes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Minor[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed typos[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved looping conversations[/p][/*][*][p]Gave some UI elements a visual overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Helpful tips for challenging parts of the game[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content:
